name: sherpa-onnx

latest_release.name: Forced alignment (fa) models
latest_release.body:
Acoustic models and pronunciation dictionaries for **forced alignment** with
[sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx) — English
(english_mfa v2.2.1 / v3.0.0 / v3.1.0) and Chinese
(aishell3_pinyin / biaobei_pinyin / large_pinyin).

Models, sources, package contents and usage are documented in
[scripts/mfa/README.md](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/blob/master/scripts/mfa/README.md).
